answer_1.quote: Researches in large vision language models (VLMs) ... have made significant progress in recent years, facilitating various vision tasks via language interactions.
answer_1.outputs: generated captions and responses to visual questions

answer_2.quote: For OCR tasks, we compute the ANLS score between the predicted OCR contents and the ground truth ones, resulting in scores ranging from 0 to 1.

answer_3.quote: We feed the candidate captions and ground truth ones to Azure GPT4O API, and ask the model to judge the candidate caption quality based on the precision and recall of visual elements.

answer_4.quote: To further validate the advantage of the data quality of our SAIL-Caption dataset, we also task human experts to evaluate the data quality.
answer_4.guideline: We instruct the annotators to judge candidate caption quality based on the original image. ... First, compare the two captions using GSB criteria: Win (1 > 2), Lose (2 > 1), Tie (1 = 2). Subsequently, assign absolute scores (1-5) to each caption independently.
